correctness.rationale: Starting from Chiclana's exact 2026 identity n(ell_p^2)=M_p for p>2, derive strictly unique stationary maximum by monotone hyperbolic product. Elementary stationarity inequalities localize y=t_p^p at Theta(2/p). A controlled expansion of the exact stationary equation gives y=epsilon/4+epsilon^2[1+log(epsilon/4)]/8+O(epsilon^3 log^2 epsilon), and substitution into a uniformly controlled objective expansion gives 1+(epsilon/2)[log(epsilon/4)-1]+(epsilon^2/8)[log^2(epsilon/4)+1]+O(epsilon^3 log^3 epsilon). The displayed theorem follows for epsilon=2/p; a standalone finite checker independently corroborates values but is not relied on as an infinite proof.

The asymptotic has a singular log p/p deficit and nontrivial second-order log-squared coefficient. The optimizing coordinate t_p^p has the sharp 1/(2p) boundary layer and its first correction.
